title.content: Why This Isn't Like The Others

rows.label: Delivery
rows.us: decision drills — you choose, under time pressure, and find out what you got wrong

rows.label: Trustworthy results
rows.them: the client reports its own score
rows.us: scores are written server-side; the browser cannot forge one

rows.label: Unlock rule
rows.them: a boolean flag in client state
rows.us: fails closed — if the server cannot confirm, it stays locked

rows.label: Replay
rows.us: a keyed points ledger rejects a duplicated completion

rows.label: Privacy
rows.them: connect your account, enter real data, upload receipts
rows.us: nothing leaves the device — the exercise runs locally

rows.label: Reactivity
rows.us: a retired quest disappears — assignments withdrawn

closing.content: A national hotline reached 4% recovery. Awareness was never the missing piece — practice is.
